title: First hearing in Micron lawsuit will be streamed online today from Albany
summary: A court hearing regarding a lawsuit against Micron Technology's chipmaking project in Central New York is being streamed online from Albany. This litigation represents potential risk to a major economic development initiative in the region. The CIO should monitor for any digital infrastructure or transparency requirements that may emerge from ongoing proceedings.
